proposed_contract.authority: Recorded mode is parsed request telemetry only. It is not proof of successful operation, action execution, authority, or capability closure.
proposed_contract.execution: Call parser.parse_args(args) exactly once. Return its real Namespace unchanged on success and propagate its original SystemExit on failure.
proposed_contract.mode_option_contract: mode_options is a complete explicit tuple of canonical declared long options representing operational command vocabulary for that CLI. It is not an authority claim and does not prove that the corresponding body branch ran.
proposed_contract.parse_observation: run_timed_entrypoint installs an invocation-local ContextVar. The helper records actual successful Namespace and selected mode only on the first successful helper parse. run_timed_entrypoint reads the observation when emitting timing telemetry and then resets the context.
proposed_contract.runtime_admission: For each listed option, exactly one registered actual argparse Action must match; option/destination must be unambiguous; supported action type and neutral default must be established; actual parsed namespace must select at most one. Mode label is the declared long option without the -- prefix, never a destination-name or prefix inference.
proposed_contract.unknown: Emit unknown mode and output format when parse fails, mode metadata is missing/malformed/unregistered/ambiguous, action type is unsupported/custom, a selected field has non-neutral or indistinguishable default, multiple modes are selected, parser helper is called repeatedly, or the entrypoint bypasses the helper.

prototype.limits: Prototype is feasibility evidence only. It used live argparse group/action internals and does not implement the owner-approved explicit mode_options API.
